messages:
Elena Morris: Need a one-page solution brief + micro-landing for enterprise buyers. Focus: Security controls, SLA commitments, and deployment choices (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Outcome: concise copy, procurement checklist, lead-routing rules, and a benchmark highlight. Ideas?

Derek Shaw: Headline suggestion: 'Secure, SLA-backed inference that fits regulated environments.' Keep subheads: Data Controls, Reliability, Deployment Options. Each 2-3 bullets max.

Harpreet Singh: Add inbound routing early. Form fields: deployment_preference, compliance_level, expected_monthly_tokens, procurement_timeline_days. Routing rule: if compliance_level==high OR expected_monthly_tokens>5e6 OR procurement_timeline_days<30 => AE. If deployment_preference==Private => SolutionsEng + Security.

Nora Blake: Procurement checklist to include: DPA, network diagram, IP allowlist, SOC2 evidence (only if available), contracting timeline (Hosted: 14-30 days, Dedicated: 30-60 days), sample SLA phrasing. Keep it short.

OpsBot: Shared template: https://drive.redwood.ai/templates/onepager-enterprise-v3 (marketing+sales). Benchmarks folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/2025-q2.

Gabe Lin: For bench callout, propose conservative copy: "Internal Redwood lab: Dedicated + KV caching + 8-bit quantization reduced unit cost ~25% at steady-state embedding throughput; p99 generation latency ~110ms on our benchmark model. Internal results; customer workloads will vary."

Elena Morris: Good. Also want a tiny decision matrix: quick pick guide (Hosted = fastest onboarding, Dedicated = predictable throughput + lower unit cost, Private = air-gapped / regulatory).

Derek Shaw: Visual idea: three small icons (shield, clock, stack) and a boxed benchmark with the one-line stat Gabe suggested. CTA A/B: "Request enterprise trial" vs "Schedule secure review". Route click A -> trial flow + optional AE follow, B -> AE booking.

Harpreet Singh: Legal phrasing: use qualifiers. Example sentence: "Supports customer-managed KMS, VPC/private control plane options, audit logs, and configurable data retention. SLA-backed uptime subject to standard exclusions (scheduled maintenance, force majeure)." Do not assert certifications unless validated.

Nora Blake: AE playbook bullets: typical timeline, required docs, who to loop (Solutions Eng, Security), and quick negotiation tips (PO vs SOW preference, example pricing bands). Keep as 3 bullets.

Gabe Lin: Webinar tie-in: 30-min technical session + Q&A. Date idea: Dec 14. Slides: 1) problem, 2) architecture (routing, caching, KMS), 3) benchmark, 4) procurement playbook, 5) CTA. Promo channels: blog, targeted email to trial users, in-product banner. Dry run Dec 12.

Elena Morris: Action items: @Gabe finalize benchmark blurb + slide draft; @Harpreet produce lead-routing JSON and form snippet; @Nora draft procurement checklist + SLA sample; @Derek design hero variants. I'll assemble the one-pager and circulate by Tue EOD.

Derek Shaw: Lead form JSON example for engineering handoff: `{"deployment_preference":"Hosted|Dedicated|Private","compliance_level":"low|medium|high","expected_monthly_tokens":number,"procurement_timeline_days":number}`. Also add radio: "route_to_sales": true|false.

Harpreet Singh: Confirmed. I'll add routing logic to marketing playbook and include example zap/webhook mapping: self-serve -> CRM lead type = "trial", AE -> lead type = "enterprise", Private -> tag "security-review".

Nora Blake: Procurement checklist draft: 1) DPA & security questionnaire, 2) Network architecture & IP allowlist, 3) Contract & PO lead time (Dedicated: 30-60 days), 4) Required contacts (AE, Solutions Eng, Security reviewer).

Gabe Lin: Benchmark visuals: cost per 1M tokens small bar chart (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Self-host). Keep numbers conservative and labeled "internal lab results".

Elena Morris: Final copy constraints: one page max, single-column PDF, 3 bullets per pillar, include boxed benchmark, and single CTA (we'll A/B test). Legal to sign-off before publish. Ready to sync Fri 10AM.

OpsBot: Meeting created: Fri 10AM. Template copied to marketing drive.

Derek Shaw: Thanks team. I'll start the hero mockups and share Figma link.

Harpreet Singh: Will route the lead JSON and webhook map by EOD tomorrow.

Nora Blake: I'll loop legal for final phrasing review once copy is in.
